adjacentEmailsExcluded.reasonExcluded: The university page presents this as the general station contact. The first-party WOLF Radio submission page explicitly directs music to the separate music-director mailbox.

businessContact.emailStatus: One first-party-published, purpose-aligned music-director mailbox was retained. The current domain-aligned general station mailbox was verified but excluded because it is not the canonical music-submission route.
businessContact.verification: Email verification was limited to first-party publication, syntax and purpose/context alignment. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

formBoundary.captchaStatus: not applicable to the published email route
formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: The route is an editorial email submission. Geographic eligibility, final pitch content, link accessibility, radio-edit status, rights, attachment policy and unpublished editorial requirements require human judgment before sending.

activityVerification.evidence: WOLF Radio's official site exposes a live-listening surface and current station content, including WOLFstock 2026. The University of West Georgia published a June 9, 2026 feature describing WOLF Radio and WOLF Sports Network as active 24/7 college-radio stations and continues to list WOLF Radio as an experiential-learning station for a global audience.

genreFitEvidence: WOLF Radio's official submission page says the station seeks local and unsigned artists and asks for radio edits.
WOLFstock 2026 featured dubstep/riddim, indie-folk, pop with funk and rock, ethereal lo-fi pop, psychedelic alternative and cloud rap artists.
A carefully selected clean MarcsMusic electronic, bass, dubstep, alternative, chill or genre-blending track has plausible medium fit, although local artists may receive stronger priority.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The route is active, first-party and free-first, but it is an editorial email route using an external Gmail mailbox. The station requests radio edits and permits a SoundCloud page or other listenable outlet, while international eligibility, subject-line format, track-count limits, attachment policy, technical specifications, metadata requirements, rights declarations, release window and AI-origin policy are unpublished. Final track selection, eligibility confirmation, pitch preparation and sending must remain human-controlled.

The general university-domain station mailbox, staff contacts, listener request surfaces, member login and social channels are excluded.

notes: One new WOLF Radio opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. No email, attachment, link, account, login, CAPTCHA, payment or submission action was completed.
